in_arabic.name: أيسر
in_arabic.meaning: سهولة، يسر، سعة في الرزق والخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أيسر مشتق من الجذر اللغوي يسّر، ويعني التيسير والسهولة في الأمور، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الليل 'إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا'، يدل على أن الله ييسر الأمور بعد العسر، ويمنح الرزق والخير الوفير لمن ييسر على نفسه وعلى الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: ایسر
in_urdu.meaning: آسانی، سہولت، وسعت در رزق و خیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایسر کا نام لغوی جذر ایس سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے آسانی اور سہولت، قرآن مجید میں سورة اللیل میں 'إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا' آیا ہے، جو اس بات کی دلالت کرتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالی مشکلات کے ساتھ آسانی بھی فراہم کرتا ہے، اور جو لوگ اپنے آپ کو اور دوسروں کو آسان بناتے ہیں ان کو وافر رزق اور خیر سے نوازتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आयसर
in_hindi.meaning: आसानी, सुलभता, भरपूर जीवन और सुख
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयसर नाम का अर्थ है आसानी और सुलभता, यह नाम अरबी जड़ से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है सुख और समृद्धि, कुरआन में लिखा है 'إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا' यह आयसर नाम के महत्व को दर्शाता है, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रेरणादायक है जो जीवन में आसानी और शांति चाहते हैं।

in_pashto.name: آيسر
in_pashto.meaning: آساني، سهولت، په رزق او خير کې پراخي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د آيسر نوم مانا آساني او سهولت دی، دا نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، قرآن کريم کې يې 'إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا' ذکر کړی، دا د الله تعالی د آسانۍ او پراخ رزق د نعمت په اړه دلالت کوي، هغه کسانو ته چې په خپلو کړو او په نورو باندې آساني کوي.

in_english.name: Ayser
in_english.meaning: Ease, comfort, abundance in livelihood and goodness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ayser is derived from the Arabic root 'y-s-r', which means ease, comfort, and abundance. In the Quran, Surah Al-Layl states 'Verily, with hardship comes ease', signifying that Allah provides ease after difficulties and bestows abundant livelihood and goodness upon those who facilitate for themselves and others. The name Ayser symbolizes serenity, prosperity, and divine blessings.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ayser is of Arabic origin, and its meaning, "comparable to the moonlight," is a reflection of the Islamic value placed on beauty. In many cultures, especially in the Islamic world, beauty is not just a physical attribute but is also associated with inner qualities such as kindness, generosity, and goodness. This name signifies the idea of a woman who embodies both external and internal beauty, which can inspire a sense of admiration and respect in others.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the concept of beauty is connected to spirituality. The Quran poetically describes Allah as the "Most Beautiful" and "Most Majestic" (Al-Jamal and Al-Khaleeq), highlighting the connection between beauty and the divine. Ayser's name represents the idea of inner and outer beauty being reflections of the divine beauty of Allah, serving as a reminder of the spiritual essence behind earthly attributes. Furthermore, the name may be a reminder for women to strive to be like the moon – consistent, nurturing, and resilient – rather than simply being obsessed with physical beauty.

historical_references.reference: Ayser ibn Abi Tri'dad al-Khawlan was a prominent poet from the pre-Islamic Arabian tribe of Khawlah. He is known for his panegyric verses dedicated to the pre-Islamic Arabian warrior-kings of his time, such as Al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib and Al-Mundhir III ibn Sawa. He is believed to have lived in the 5th and 6th centuries CE.
historical_references.context: Poet and panegyrist for pre-Islamic Arabian warrior-kings

historical_references.reference: Ayser al-Din al-Isfahani was a Persian historian, scholar, and poet, born in Isfahan, Persia, around 1135 CE. He is known for his work 'Aghani al-Akhbar' which is a collection of over 30,000 lines of poetry and prose, documenting the history and culture of the Islamic world during the Middle Ages. He is considered an important figure in the development of Persian literature and historiography.
historical_references.context: Historian, scholar, and poet; author of 'Aghani al-Akhbar'
